informe_victimas_2025.name: Informe de víctimas de homicidios consumados 2025 (Tabla 1: victims by region 2018-2025; Tabla 2: rate per 100,000 by region 2018-2025; Tabla 26: communes with homicide victims in 2025)
informe_victimas_2025.publisher: Centro para la Prevención de Homicidios y Delitos Violentos (Ministerio Público / Fiscalía de Chile), data from the Observatorio de Homicidios (interinstitutional)
informe_victimas_2025.notes: Extracted from PDF with pdftotext -layout. Checks: region counts sum to the published national total in every year 2018-2025; commune counts sum to 1,091 = national 2025 total. Thousands separators removed and decimal commas converted to points. Tabla 26 lists only communes that had at least one victim in 2025; communes not listed are not given as zero here (the report implies zero but we did not add rows). The report's per-region summary tables (Tablas 10-25: percentages by weapon, context, nationality, sex, place) were not extracted. Region rates for 2025 use INE projections and the report notes they will be adjusted.
